verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents custom quotas that cap the amount of data processed per day at the project or user level, explicitly to control costs (bigquery-docs-63, bigquery-docs-76, bigquery-docs-118). Community users corroborate per-query byte limits plus custom quotas as the safeguard, but note that a looping script can get past a per-query limit (bigquery-comm-6). The $14k surprise bill shows these guards are not on by default, not that they fail (bigquery-comm-1-refresh-4c1f88658aaf2867). Missing for 10: documented budget alerts or auto-stop for reserved slot capacity, idle-compute suspension for reservations, evidence that safeguards are enabled by default, and hands-on confirmation that the daily quota halts a runaway overnight job.
